card.name: Small joints inside label headers and phrases
card.fires_on: Punctuation and short linking words in the middle of a label or header phrase, such as a comma after an institution, a closing parenthesis, or 'for' and 'that' after a drug or patient group. The next words continue a description.

modes.label: Closing marks in headers
modes.description: A comma, dash or closing parenthesis that ends a name or heading and is followed by a description.
